DECLARE @sDt DATETIME DECLARE @eDt DATETIME DECLARE @SaCD VARCHAR(10) DECLARE @Flag INT DECLARE @Buser VARCHAR(10)
SET @sDt = #{searchFromDate} SET @eDt = #{searchToDate} SET @SaCD = #{searchId} SET @Flag = #{ccHomeFlag} SET @Buser = dbo.GetSaBuser(@SaCD, @eDt)
SELECT cc_Code , cc_Flag , cc_FgNm , cc_Date , cc_Day , cc_Title , cc_SignCnt , cc_Sign1 , cc_SignTt1 , cc_SignOK1 , cc_Sign2 , cc_SignTt2 , cc_SignOK2 , cc_Sign3 , cc_SignTt3 , cc_SignOK3 , cc_Sign4 , cc_SignTt4 , cc_SignOK4 , cc_Sign5 , cc_SignTt5 , cc_SignOK5 , cc_Sign6 , cc_SignTt6 , cc_SignOK6 , cc_Sign7 , cc_SignTt7 , cc_SignOK7 , cc_Sign8 , cc_SignTt8 , cc_SignOK8 , cc_ReSign , cc_RMK , cc_Seq = CASE WHEN cc_Flag = 'PL' THEN ( SELECT MAX(Pi_Seq) FROM I_PaperInout WHERE Pi_Date = cc_Date AND Pi_SignUK = cc_Code ) WHEN cc_Flag = 'FC' THEN ( SELECT MAX(Fc_Flag) FROM I_FirstCopy WHERE Fc_ElecUK = cc_Code ) ELSE 0 END , cc_ReRMK , cc_ReSignDt , cc_ImgNO , cc_Buser , cc_SRDFg , cc_Level , cc_Fg , cc_Plseq , cc_RMK1 , fcNum , cc_OK = CASE WHEN cc_SignCnt = cc_OK THEN CASE WHEN cc_Flag = 'OF' THEN CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM P_Offday WHERE Od_Code = CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(cc_Sign1,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(cc_Sign1,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(cc_Sign1,'') END AND Od_UK = cc_Code) > 0 THEN cc_OK ELSE 0 END WHEN cc_Flag = 'OR' THEN CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM O_OSOrderList WHERE Or_ElecUK = cc_Code AND ISNULL(Or_Cancel,0) = 0) > 0 THEN cc_OK ELSE 0 END ELSE cc_OK END ELSE cc_OK END , cc_OK1 = CASE WHEN cc_SignCnt = cc_OK THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, cc_Use = ISNULL(Ea_Use,'Y'), cc_OK, cc_Form = Hc_Code1, cc_ImgNO2, cc_SeFg , cc_SignOR = CASE WHEN cc_So = 1 THEN ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM I_ElecsignOrder WHERE Eo_Code = cc_Code),0) ELSE 0 END, cc_So1 FROM ( SELECT cc_Code = Es_Code , cc_Flag = Es_Flag , cc_FgNm = Hc_Name , cc_Date = Es_Date , cc_Day = DATENAME(WEEKDAY,Es_Date), cc_Title = Es_Title , cc_SignCnt = ISNULL(Es_SignCnt,CASE WHEN Es_Flag = 'OR' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END) , cc_Sign1 = Es_Sign1, cc_SignTt1 = CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_Sign1,'') = '' THEN '' ELSE CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_SignDt1,'') = '' THEN '□ ' ELSE '▣ ' END + dbo.GetSaJikGub(CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign1,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign1,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign1,'') END,Es_Date,ISNULL(hc_ratio,3)) + '(' + Ic_Name + ')' END, cc_SignOK1 = CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_SignDt1,'') = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, cc_Sign2 = Es_Sign2, cc_SignTt2 = CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_Sign2,'') = '' THEN '' ELSE CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_SignDt2,'') = '' THEN '□ ' ELSE '▣ ' END + dbo.GetSaJikGub(CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign2,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign2,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign2,'') END,Es_Date,ISNULL(hc_ratio,3)) END, cc_SignOK2 = CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_SignDt2,'') = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, cc_Sign3 = Es_Sign3, cc_SignTt3 = CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_Sign3,'') = '' THEN '' ELSE CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_SignDt3,'') = '' THEN '□ ' ELSE '▣ ' END + dbo.GetSaJikGub(CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign3,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign3,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign3,'') END,Es_Date,ISNULL(hc_ratio,3)) END, cc_SignOK3 = CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_SignDt3,'') = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, cc_Sign4 = Es_Sign4, cc_SignTt4 = CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_Sign4,'') = '' THEN '' ELSE CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_SignDt4,'') = '' THEN '□ ' ELSE '▣ ' END + dbo.GetSaJikGub(CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign4,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign4,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign4,'') END,Es_Date,ISNULL(hc_ratio,3)) END, cc_SignOK4 = CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_SignDt4,'') = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, cc_Sign5 = Es_Sign5, cc_SignTt5 = CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_Sign5,'') = '' THEN '' ELSE CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_SignDt5,'') = '' THEN '□ ' ELSE '▣ ' END + dbo.GetSaJikGub(CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign5,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign5,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign5,'') END,Es_Date,ISNULL(hc_ratio,3)) END, cc_SignOK5 = CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_SignDt5,'') = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, cc_Sign6 = Es_Sign6, cc_SignTt6 = CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_Sign6,'') = '' THEN '' ELSE CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_SignDt6,'') = '' THEN '□ ' ELSE '▣ ' END + dbo.GetSaJikGub(CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign6,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign6,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign6,'') END,Es_Date,ISNULL(hc_ratio,3)) END, cc_SignOK6 = CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_SignDt6,'') = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, cc_Sign7 = Es_Sign7, cc_SignTt7 = CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_Sign7,'') = '' THEN '' ELSE CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_SignDt7,'') = '' THEN '□ ' ELSE '▣ ' END + dbo.GetSaJikGub(CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign7,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign7,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign7,'') END,Es_Date,ISNULL(hc_ratio,3)) END, cc_SignOK7 = CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_SignDt7,'') = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, cc_Sign8 = Es_Sign8, cc_SignTt8 = CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_Sign8,'') = '' THEN '' ELSE CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_SignDt8,'') = '' THEN '□ ' ELSE '▣ ' END + dbo.GetSaJikGub(CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign8,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign8,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign8,'') END,Es_Date,ISNULL(hc_ratio,3)) END, cc_SignOK8 = CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_SignDt8,'') = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, cc_ReSign = ISNULL(Es_ReSign,''), cc_RMK = ISNULL(Es_RMK,''), cc_ReRMK = ISNULL(Es_ReRMK,''), cc_ReSignDt = ISNULL(Es_ReSignDt,''), cc_ImgNO = Es_ImgNO, cc_ImgNO2 = Es_ImgNO2, cc_Buser = ISNULL(Id_Job,Ic_Buser), cc_SRDFg = CONVERT(INT,Hc_Code1), cc_Level = CASE WHEN CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign1,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign1,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign1,'') END = @SaCD THEN 1 WHEN CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign2,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign2,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign2,'') END = @SaCD THEN 2 WHEN CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign3,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign3,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign3,'') END = @SaCD THEN 3 WHEN CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign4,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign4,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign4,'') END = @SaCD THEN 4 WHEN CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign5,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign5,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign5,'') END = @SaCD THEN 5 WHEN CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign6,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign6,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign6,'') END = @SaCD THEN 6 WHEN CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign7,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign7,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign7,'') END = @SaCD THEN 7 ELSE 8 END, cc_Fg = CASE WHEN CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign1,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign1,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign1,'') END = @SaCD THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, cc_Plseq = CASE WHEN Es_Flag = 'PL' THEN (SELECT Pi_Seq FROM I_PaperInout WHERE Pi_Date = Es_Date AND Pi_SignUK = Es_Code) ELSE 0 END, cc_RMK1 = CASE WHEN Es_Flag = 'OF' THEN (SELECT SUBSTRING(Ea_RMK,CHARINDEX(';',Ea_RMK) + 1,CHARINDEX('@2',Ea_RMK,10) - CHARINDEX(';',Ea_RMK) - 1) FROM I_ElecApproval WHERE Ea_Code = Es_Code) WHEN Es_Flag = 'FC' THEN (SELECT MAX(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),Fc_Date,120) + Fc_Flag + Fc_Num) FROM I_FirstCopy WHERE Fc_ElecUK = Es_Code) ELSE '' END, fcNum = CASE WHEN Es_Flag = 'FC' THEN (SELECT MAX(Fc_Num) FROM I_FirstCopy WHERE Fc_ElecUK = Es_Code) ELSE '' END, cc_OK = CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_SignDt1,'') = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_SignDt2,'') = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_SignDt3,'') = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_SignDt4,'') = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_SignDt5,'') = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_SignDt6,'') = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_SignDt7,'') = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN ISNULL(Es_SignDt8,'') = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, cc_SeFg = CASE WHEN @SaCD IN (Es_HubJo1,Es_HubJo2,Es_HubJo3,Es_HubJo4,Es_HubJo5) OR @Buser IN (Es_HubJo1,Es_HubJo2,Es_HubJo3,Es_HubJo4,Es_HubJo5) THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, cc_So = CASE WHEN ISNULL(Hc_Ratio,'') = '10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, cc_So1 = CASE WHEN Eo_SaCD = @SaCD AND ISNULL(Eo_Sign,'') = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM I_ElecSign LEFT JOIN I_HelpCD ON Hc_Code = 'Elec00' AND Hc_ColumNm = Es_Flag LEFT JOIN P_InSaCode ON Ic_Code = CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign1,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign1,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign1,'') END LEFT JOIN I_ElecsignOrder ON Eo_Code = Es_Code AND Eo_SaCD = @SaCD LEFT JOIN P_InsaDetail ON Id_code = Ic_code AND Id_DtFlag = 4 AND Id_Saflag = Ic_Saflag AND Id_Date1 = ( SELECT MAX(Id_Date1) FROM P_InsaDetail WHERE Id_code = Ic_code AND Id_DtFlag = 4 AND Id_Date1 <= Es_Date ) WHERE Es_Date BETWEEN @sDt AND @eDt
AND Es_Flag = #{ccFlag}
AND ( @Flag = CASE WHEN CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign1,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign1,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign1,'') END = @SaCD THEN 1 WHEN CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign2,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign2,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign2,'') END = @SaCD AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt1,'') <> '' THEN 1 WHEN CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign3,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign3,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign3,'') END = @SaCD AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt2,'') <> '' THEN 1 WHEN CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign4,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign4,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign4,'') END = @SaCD AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt3,'') <> '' THEN 1 WHEN CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign5,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign5,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign5,'') END = @SaCD AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt4,'') <> '' THEN 1 WHEN CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign6,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign6,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign6,'') END = @SaCD AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt5,'') <> '' THEN 1 WHEN CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign7,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign7,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign7,'') END = @SaCD AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt6,'') <> '' THEN 1 WHEN CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign8,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign8,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign8,'') END = @SaCD AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt7,'') <> '' THEN 1 WHEN @SaCD IN (Es_HubJo1,Es_HubJo2,Es_HubJo3,Es_HubJo4,Es_HubJo5) OR @Buser IN (Es_HubJo1,Es_HubJo2,Es_HubJo3,Es_HubJo4,Es_HubJo5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END OR @Flag = CASE WHEN CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign2,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign2,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign2,'') END = @SaCD AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt2,'') = '' AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt1,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(Es_ReSignDt,'') = '' THEN 2 WHEN CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign3,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign3,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign3,'') END = @SaCD AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt3,'') = '' AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt2,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(Es_ReSignDt,'') = '' THEN 2 WHEN CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign4,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign4,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign4,'') END = @SaCD AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt4,'') = '' AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt3,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(Es_ReSignDt,'') = '' THEN 2 WHEN CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign5,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign5,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign5,'') END = @SaCD AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt5,'') = '' AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt4,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(Es_ReSignDt,'') = '' THEN 2 WHEN CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign6,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign6,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign6,'') END = @SaCD AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt6,'') = '' AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt5,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(Es_ReSignDt,'') = '' THEN 2 WHEN CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign7,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign7,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign7,'') END = @SaCD AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt7,'') = '' AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt6,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(Es_ReSignDt,'') = '' THEN 2 WHEN CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign8,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign8,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign8,'') END = @SaCD AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt8,'') = '' AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt7,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(Es_ReSignDt,'') = '' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END OR @Flag = CASE WHEN @SaCD IN (ISNULL(Es_ReSign,''), ISNULL(Es_Sign1,'')) AND ISNULL(Es_ReSignDt,'') <> '' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END OR @Flag = CASE WHEN CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign2,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign2,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign2,'') END = @SaCD AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt2,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt1,'') <> '' THEN 4 WHEN CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign3,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign3,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign3,'') END = @SaCD AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt3,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt2,'') <> '' THEN 4 WHEN CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign4,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign4,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign4,'') END = @SaCD AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt4,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt3,'') <> '' THEN 4 WHEN CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign5,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign5,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign5,'') END = @SaCD AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt5,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt4,'') <> '' THEN 4 WHEN CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign6,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign6,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign6,'') END = @SaCD AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt6,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt5,'') <> '' THEN 4 WHEN CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign7,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign7,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign7,'') END = @SaCD AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt7,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt6,'') <> '' THEN 4 WHEN CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign8,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign8,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign8,'') END = @SaCD AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt8,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(Es_SignDt7,'') <> '' THEN 4 ELSE 0 END OR @Flag = CASE WHEN @SaCD IN (Es_HubJo1,Es_HubJo2,Es_HubJo3,Es_HubJo4,Es_HubJo5) OR @Buser IN (Es_HubJo1,Es_HubJo2,Es_HubJo3,Es_HubJo4,Es_HubJo5) THEN 5 ELSE 0 END OR @Flag = CASE WHEN CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign1,'')) > 6 THEN SUBSTRING(Es_Sign1,9,10) ELSE ISNULL(Es_Sign1,'') END = @SaCD THEN 6 ELSE 0 END OR @Flag = CASE WHEN Eo_SaCD = @SaCD THEN 10 ELSE 0 END ) ) TMP LEFT JOIN I_ElecApproval ON Ea_Code = cc_Code AND Ea_Seq = 10 LEFT JOIN I_HelpCD ON Hc_Code = 'Elec00' AND Hc_ColumNm = cc_Flag ORDER BY cc_Date DESC, cc_Code DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign1, '')) > 6 THEN Es_Sign1 ELSE '' END AS esSign1, CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign2, '')) > 6 THEN Es_Sign2 ELSE '' END AS esSign2, CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign3, '')) > 6 THEN Es_Sign3 ELSE '' END AS esSign3, CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign4, '')) > 6 THEN Es_Sign4 ELSE '' END AS esSign4, CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign5, '')) > 6 THEN Es_Sign5 ELSE '' END AS esSign5, CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign6, '')) > 6 THEN Es_Sign6 ELSE '' END AS esSign6, CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign7, '')) > 6 THEN Es_Sign7 ELSE '' END AS esSign7, CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign8, '')) > 6 THEN Es_Sign8 ELSE '' END AS esSign8 FROM I_ElecSign WHERE Es_Code = #{ccCode} AND Es_Flag = #{ccFlag}

SELECT Es_Code, Es_Sign1, Es_SignDt1, Es_Sign2, Es_SignDt2, Es_Sign3, Es_SignDt3, Es_Sign4, Es_SignDt4, Es_Sign5, Es_SignDt5, Es_Sign6, Es_SignDt6, Es_Sign7, Es_SignDt7, Es_Sign8, Es_SignDt8 FROM I_ElecSign WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) WHERE Es_Code = #{code}
